title: Sequencing: prototype tests
bodyMd:
Five tests are run on a prototype in order, once each. No tests overlap.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Load, Noise, Power, Seal, Temperature.

- Noise must be immediately followed by Temperature.
- Load must precede Seal.
- Exactly 1 other item must occur between Power and Seal.
